item.title: Debunking seven myths about the Buddha - Wildmind
item.description: Much of what's taught about the Buddha — that he was an Indian Hindu prince called Siddhartha Gautama who saw "four sights" — is a myth.

item.title: White Tara mantra - Wildmind
item.description: White Tara's mantra is associated with long life. We explain the meaning of this mantra and present a recording of it being chanted.
